Meze tavern · Kaimakli, Nicosia

Meze and souvla in Kaimakli

A traditional Cypriot tavern with meze, grilled meats and a large courtyard. On Google, 4.7 stars from 96 reviews.

Food

What guests order

From the menu and from what guests write in their Google reviews.

Meat meze

Salad, tahini, yogurt, pourgouri, halloumi, mushroom, loukaniko, bacon, pork souvlaki, sieftalia, chicken thigh, pork chops and fries, for two or more.

From the grill

Souvlaki, sieftalies, chicken souvlaki and souvla. One guest calls the sieftalies the best ever.

Pourgouri and aubergine

Guests praise the pourgouri, made to the chef’s own recipe, and the aubergine with tahini sauce.

Music nights

Some evenings bring live rembetiko and laiko music, and guests end up singing together.

At the tavern

Photos from the Google listing.

How guests describe a visit

Taken from what guests write in their Google reviews.

The courtyard

Guests write about a beautifully decorated courtyard, made for long evenings with friends.

Quick, friendly service

The staff walk between the tables to make sure everything is fine, guests write.

Dessert and fruit

At the end of the meal, dessert and fruit are served, one guest writes.

A tavern like in the old days

The tavern sits in the courtyard of the Achilleas Kaimakli association, with palm trees and plenty of tables outside. Guests call it one of the most traditional Cypriot taverns in Nicosia.
